department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: Farmer families who own farm land get Rs 6,000 a year. It comes as three payments of Rs 2,000, one every four months, straight into the bank account.

other: The family must have farm land in their own names.
Land size does not matter. Big and small farmers can both get it.
Not for families where any member paid income tax last year.
Not for land held by institutions.
Not for families with a minister, MP, MLA, mayor or other constitutional post holder (now or before).
Not for serving or retired government officers and staff (Group D / Class IV / Multi Tasking Staff are allowed).
Not for retired people with a pension of Rs 10,000 or more a month (Group D / Class IV / Multi Tasking Staff are allowed).
Not for doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants and architects who are registered and working.

how_to_apply: Go to a Common Service Centre (CSC). The worker there types your Aadhaar, bank and land details, uploads your land paper, Aadhaar and bank passbook, and saves the form. Later you can check your status with your Aadhaar number.
